name: psi_r_adverse_ties — tie spacing CANNOT masquerade as the 6db disjunct: tieSpacing = 100 in with s_hooked < 6db must stay psi_r = 1.6 (AUDIT-FIXES A2 adverse case, H4)

hand: This is the mandatory adverse fixture for the audit's incorrect 's <= 6db' tie-spacing reading of Table 25.4.3.2.
The 6db spacing disjunct belongs to the c/c spacing of the HOOKED BARS being developed; TIE spacing only enters
through Ath (ties within 15db of the hook). A 100 in tie spacing therefore must NOT earn psi_r = 1.0:
hooked bars: 4-#8 in b_gb 16, side cover 2 -> s_hooked = (16-4-1)/3 = 3.66667 in < 6db = 6.0 -> disjunct (b) fails.
(A naive 's >= 6db means tie spacing' implementation would read 100 >= 6 and hand out 1.0 — unconservative by 1.6x.)

values.note: MUST stay 1.6: wide tie spacing shrinks Ath (nTies = 1), and the hooked bars themselves are closer than 6db
